65830.commentary: (APAa) vaḍḍhakīhi kathāpetvā'ti bhojanasālāya pamāṇaṃ kittakan'ti pamāṇaṃ kathāpetvāti attho. (APt) usumhi, usukāro vā vaḍḍhakī usuvaḍḍhakī, etena vaḍḍhakīsaddassa sabbesam'pi sippikānaṃ vācakatā dīpitā, tena suvaṇṇavaḍḍhakī, tantavaḍḍhakīty'ādayo'pi yojjā.

examples.text: sace hi vīriyaṃ n'āssa, kammaṃ kalyāṇapāpakaṃ, na bhare vaḍḍhakiṃ rājā, na'pi yantāni kāraye.
bahū nāvā samānetvā, vaḍḍhakīhi susaṅkhataṃ, nāvāya chadanaṃ katvā, paṭimāniṃ nar'āsabhaṃ.

65834.commentary: (SNa) sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhanan'ti sabbaṃ taṃ kāmavitakk'ādivaḍḍhanaṃ. (DNa) hāyanavaḍḍhane'ti n'atthi hāyanavaḍḍhanāni. na saṃsāro paṇḍitassa hāyati, na bālassa vaḍḍhatī'ti attho.

examples.text: ye me pubbe viyākaṃsu, huraṃ gotamasāsanā, icc'āsi iti bhavissati, sabbaṃ taṃ itih'ītihaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhanaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha abhiramiṃ.
doṇamite sukhadukkhe pariyantakate saṃsāre, n'atthi hāyanavaḍḍhane, n'atthi ukkaṃs'āvakaṃse.

uday'atthiko'ti vaḍḍhi-atthiko.

atha kho so aggiko jaṭilo taṃ dārakaṃ assamaṃ netvā āpādesi posesi vaḍḍhesi.
pāṇimhi ce vaṇo n'āssa, hareyya pāṇinā visaṃ, n'ābbaṇaṃ visam'anveti, n'atthi pāpaṃ akubbato.
tassa so bhisakko sallakatto satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikanteyya. satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikantitvā esaniyā sallaṃ eseyya.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gaṇḍo anekavassagaṇiko. tass'assu gaṇḍassa nava vaṇamukhāni nava abhedanamukhāni. tato yaṃ kiñci pagghareyya, asuci'y'eva pagghareyya, duggandhaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya, jegucchiyaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya.
kālena kālañ'ca vaṇaṃ dhoveyyāsi, kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpeyyāsi, mā te na kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhovato na kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpato pubbalohitaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ pariyonandhi.

idha, bhikkhave, kulaputto yena sippaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti, yadi muddāya yadi gaṇanāya yadi saṅkhānena yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sipp'aññatarena.

65885.meaning2: country where trade is going on
65885.commentary: (UDa) yāvatā vaṇippatho'ti yattakaṃ vāṇijānaṃ āhaṭabhaṇḍassa rāsivasena kayavikkayaṭṭhānaṃ nāma, vāṇijānaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ vā atthi.

examples.text: yāvatā, ānanda, ariyaṃ āyatanaṃ yāvatā vaṇippatho idaṃ agganagaraṃ bhavissati pāṭaliputtaṃ puṭabhedanaṃ.
hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse tālavaṇṭena'pi vidhūpanena'pi vātaṃ pariyesanti, ossavane'pi tiṇāni na icchanti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ambapiṇḍiyā vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni tattha ambāni vaṇṭapaṭibandhāni sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ambapiṇḍiyā vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni kānici ambāni vaṇṭapaṭibandhāni, sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ambapiṇḍiyā vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni kānici ambāni vaṇṭapaṭibandhāni, sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ambapiṇḍiyā vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni kānici ambāni vaṇṭ'ūpanibandhanāni, sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti,

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, uppalassa vā padumassa vā puṇḍarīkassa vā gandho. yo nu kho evaṃ vadeyya, pattassa gandho'ti vā vaṇḍassa gandho'ti vā kiñjakkhassa gandho'ti vā sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyā'ti? no h'etaṃ, āvuso.
āyuṃ arogiyaṃ vaṇṇaṃ, saggaṃ uccākulīnataṃ, ratiyo patthayantena, uḷārā apar'āparā.
tesaṃ taṃ vaṇṇāya c'eva hoti balāya ca, na ca tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇapaṭibhāgāni
kusāvatiyā, ānanda, rājadhāniyā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dvārāni ahesuṃ. ekaṃ dvāraṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ, ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ, ekaṃ veḷuriyamayaṃ, ekaṃ phalikamayaṃ.

65896.commentary: (SNa) kena vaṇṇo pasīdatī'ti kena kāraṇena chavivaṇṇo pasīdatī'ti pucchati.

examples.text: tassa te n'atthi bhītattaṃ, bhiyyo vaṇṇo pasīdati, kasmā na paridevesi, evarūpe mahabbhaye.
araññe viharantānaṃ, santānaṃ brahmacārinaṃ, ekabhattaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, kena vaṇṇo pasīdatī'ti.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, cattāro vaṇṇā, khattiyā, brāhmaṇā, vessā, suddā te tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, samaṇā sakyaputtiyā tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti
na harāmi na bhañjāmi, ārā siṅghāmi vārijaṃ, atha kena nu vaṇṇena, gandhattheno'ti vuccati.
